issues: Serial output contains markdown fences and heading (## Simulated Serial Monitor Output, ``` code blocks). The prompt asks for plain-text serial log but Claude wraps output in markdown. Consider stripping code fences / markdown before rendering, or tightening the prompt to enforce 'no markdown, no headings — output the raw lines only'.

rca of the issue: No blocking issues. Serial output includes markdown wrapping (## heading, ``` fence) because the LLM defaults to markdown when writing into the JSON `explanation` field. Reproduction: click serial-preview-btn on a generated Blink sketch → observe headings/fences in serial-output. Mitigation: add explicit constraint in PromptBuilder.MODES['serial'] such as 'Return ONLY the raw serial lines. No markdown, no code fences, no headings. Start directly with the first line the microcontroller would print.'
